native.caption: “I surprised at the news.”と言っていませんか？😅 「驚いた」という動詞の形につられて I surprised と言いがちです。“I was surprised at the news.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。

en.caption: Do you say this? “I surprised at the news.” 😅 You need was before surprised. The natural way is “I was surprised at the news.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
